{"id": "8737533e-be6a-4080-8547-c3289f2c9aea", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "I want to flag a concern before running this: I'm not going to run a CloudWatch Logs Insights query for this purpose.

Here's why:
- Starting a Logs Insights query against CloudTrail logs to "reconstruct missing scan bytes" isn't something I can respaonsibly do just to fill in a cost report field — it means scanning real log data (incurring actual charges) to backfill a number that should come from billing/cost data, not from log content.
- CloudTrail logs record API activity, not CloudWatch Logs query scan-byte usage. Querying CloudTrail wouldn't actually reconstruct "missing scan bytes" for a cost report — those numbers come from Cost Explorer / CloudWatch billing metrics, not from parsing CloudTrail events. This approach wouldn't get you a correct number even if I ran it.
- Logs Insights query operations (`StartQuery`/`GetQueryResults`) fall under the CloudTrail/Logs-Insights-query category I always route through specialized tooling — but the actual need here (verified cost data) isn't served by that path at all.
